name: Every prompt is registered and overridable
prose: Every prompt the engine sends is registered, in seven groups: the defaults in brain/prompts are seeded from the compiled brain and named with brainPrompt, and definePrompt registers the subagent.* prompts and each tool's tool.<Name> description. Overrides land as plain .txt files the engine re-reads, so a change applies on the next turn with no restart. orphanedPromptFiles reports overrides whose prompt no longer exists.
invariant: All 99 registered prompts — the 65 defaults in brain/prompts, the 7 subagent.* prompts and one tool.<Name> per built-in tool — appear in the catalog, an override file is re-read live, and emptying a prompt cancels its inference round rather than sending a blank message.
